name: text_to_speech
description: Convert text to speech audio. Returns a MEDIA: path that the platform delivers as native audio. In CLI mode, saves to the configured output directory or voice-memos/.

text.description: The text to convert to speech. Provider-specific per-request character caps apply automatically (OpenAI 4096, xAI 15000, MiniMax 10000, ElevenLabs 5000); longer input is split into ordered chunks without silent truncation.

output_path.description: Optional output file path inside the working directory or profile voice-memos folder.

speed.description: Playback speed multiplier. 1.0 = normal, 0.5 = very slow, 2.0 = fast. Range: 0.25-4.0. Overrides the speed configured in config.yaml.

instructions.description: Optional voice-design guidance: tone, emotion, pacing, accent, whispering, impressions. Forwarded to OpenAI-compatible backends and silently ignored by backends that don't support it.

voice.description: Optional voice name or ID override for this call.
